Long AddCustomRibbonItem ( String  label,
String  userData,
Integer  smallImageIndex,
Integer  largeImageIndex 
)

Adds an item (or subitem) to a custom ribbon tab.

Parameters:
labelas String, specifies the menu item name with full menu path (for example, "Item1@Tab1").
userDataas String, which lets you uniquely identify the command without using label (which might change).
smallImageIndexas Integer, specifies the small icon index, which is the zero-based position in the image list file (smallImageList) specified in AddCustomRibbonTab().
largeImageIndexas Integer, specifies the large icon index, which is the zero-based position in the image list file (largeImageList) specified in AddCustomRibbonTab().
Returns:
0: Success
1: Failure
See also:
AddCustomRibbonTab()
UpdateCustomRibbon()
Long AddCustomRibbonTab ( Integer  position,
String  label,
String  smallImageList,
String  largeImageList 
)

Adds a custom tab to the Composer ribbon.

For example: 

  ' Custom Ribbon Tab
  nPosition = -1
  MyApp.AddCustomRibbonTab(nPosition, "Custom Tab", _
                           CurDir() + "\SmallImageListSample.png", _
                           CurDir() + "\LargeImageListSample.png")

  'MyApp.AddCustomRibbonTab(1, "Ribbon1", "", "")
  'MyApp.AddCustomRibbonTab(2, "Ribbon2", "", "")

  'group 1
  MyApp.AddCustomRibbonItem("Command 1@Group 1@Custom Tab", "Command1", 6, 6)
  MyApp.AddCustomRibbonItem("Command 2@Group 1@Custom Tab", "Command2", 22, -1)
  'MyApp.AddCustomRibbonItem("Command 10@Group 1@Custom Tab", "Command10", -1, -1)
  MyApp.AddCustomRibbonItem("Group 1@Custom Tab", "", -1, -1) 'separator
  MyApp.AddCustomRibbonItem("Command 3@Group 1@Custom Tab", "Command3", 23, -1)

  'group 2
  MyApp.AddCustomRibbonItem("Command 4@Group 2@Custom Tab", "Command4", 12, -1)
  MyApp.AddCustomRibbonItem("Command 5@Group 2@Custom Tab", "Command5", 13, -1)
Parameters:
positionas Integer, specifies the tab position:

  • 1: First tab
  • -1: Last tab
labelas String, specifies the tab name (for example, "Tab1").
smallImageListas String, specifies the image list file for small icons (16x16).
largeImageListas String, specifies the image list file for large icons (32x32).
Returns:
0: Success
1: Failure
See also:
AddCustomRibbonItem()
UpdateCustomRibbon()
Long AddMenu ( Integer  documentType,
Integer  position,
String  menuLabel 
)

This function is deprecated. Use AddCustomRibbonTab().

Adds a custom menu to the Composer main menu.

Parameters:
documentTypeas Integer (CrDocumentType bit mask), specifies when to display the menu:

  • crDtNoOpenedDoc (1): No document open
  • crDt3D (2): 3D document open
  • crDtNoOpenedDoc + crDt3D (3): Both
positionas Integer, specifies the menu position, 1 being first.
menuLabelas String, specifies the menu name (for example, "Menu1").
Returns:
0: Success
1: Failure (bad document type)
See also:
AddCustomRibbonTab()
Long AddMenuItem ( Integer  documentType,
String  menuItem,
String  userData 
)

This function is deprecated. Use AddCustomRibbonItem().

Adds an item (submenu) to a custom menu.

Parameters:
documentTypeas Integer (CrDocumentType bit mask), specifies when to display the menu item:

  • crDtNoOpenedDoc (1): No document open
  • crDt3D (2): 3D document open
  • crDtNoOpenedDoc + crDt3D (3): Both
menuItemas String, specifies the menu item name with full menu path (for example, "Item1@Menu1").
userDataas String, which lets you uniquely identify the command without using menuItem (which might change).
Returns:
0: Success
1: Failure (bad document type)
See also:
AddCustomRibbonItem()

void Show ( CrWindowVisibility  show )

Sets the application window state.

Parameters:
showas CrWindowVisibility enum, specifies the window state:

  • crViHide: Hides the window and activates another window.
  • crViShow: Activates the window with its current size and position.
  • crViMinimize: Minimizes the window and activates the next top-level window in the Z order.
  • crViMaximize: Maximizes the window.
  • crViShowMinimized: Activates the window and minimizes it.
  • crViShowMaximized: Activates the window and maximizes it.
  • crViRestore: Activates and displays the window. If the window is minimized or maximized, it is restored to its original size and position. Specify this flag when restoring a minimized window.
Returns:
None
